report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94 ms durations; logs show info-level 200s and metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~98 ms. No error, latency, saturation, or deployment-caused signal is present, so no public cause is substantiated. Handing off rather than asserting a fault.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to judge whether 63-94 ms is anomalous
Downstream dependency latency/error metrics for order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis
Error or timeout logs from order and downstream services during the window
Resource saturation metrics (CPU, memory, DB pool) for gateway and order
